continuity_scope: Pass limited to Brian McClellan's Promise of Blood, Orbit trade paperback ISBN 9780316219044, Book One only. Excludes the rest of the Powder Mage trilogy, sequel trilogy, novellas, RPG material, and adaptations.
coverage_rule: Eight named individual dramatic characters across the novel's multiple viewpoints. Military ranks, factions, powder-mage/Privileged/Knacked categories, gods, magic, weapons, places, and political structures remain dimensions or terms rather than relationship endpoints.
omissions: Books Two and Three, sequel trilogy, novellas, RPG material, and adaptation material.
Collective political/military/fantasy-category nodes, gods, artifacts, places, and institutions.
uncertainties: The coup's motives, foreign involvement, and prophecy are discovered unevenly across viewpoints.

evidence_basis: Primary claims use the declared Orbit printed witness and chapter loci; Orbit/Hachette and McClellan's official page establish edition and author context.

supports: Declared edition, author, publisher, and Book One description.
